name: freshrove
description: Discover places, local businesses, stays, product presentations, experiences and culture through Freshrove’s curated published recommendations. Search in Greek or English, continue through result pages, and follow source links to Freshrove. Where available, the service provides up to three real cover images per search. This integration provides public discovery; it does not complete purchases or reservations or access private administration, contracts or payment records.

capabilities: Read description excerpts and source links
defaultPrompt: Find the Freshrove listing for Egnatia City Hotel & Spa.
Show more results from my last Freshrove search.

positive.prompt: Search Freshrove for Καβάλα with lang="gr", limit=10, offset=0 and includePhotos=false.
positive.expected_behavior: Return published Freshrove results with plain Greek name/description fields, source URLs and honest pagination metadata. Equal-relevance results may include different matching content families. Do not invent translations or availability.

positive.description: Continue a destination search without repeating the previous page
positive.prompt: Continue the preceding Καβάλα search with lang="gr", limit=10, offset=10 and includePhotos=false.
positive.expected_behavior: Under an unchanged catalog, return the next result page with IDs distinct from offset=0, the same total and an accurate hasMore value. Do not claim the first ten results are the entire catalog.

positive.description: Search the same destination in English
positive.prompt: Search Freshrove for Kavala with lang="en", limit=10 and includePhotos=false.
positive.expected_behavior: Return published English result fields and English source URLs where available, with plain text rather than serialized locale objects. Report the actual returned results and pagination.

positive.description: Find a known published accommodation listing
positive.prompt: Find the Freshrove listing for Egnatia City Hotel & Spa in Kavala. Use English.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for the named property and return its Freshrove source page under /en/unique-hotels/egnatia-city-hotel-spa-kavala when present. Describe only the published information, without inventing room availability, rates or a booking confirmation.

positive.description: Show real cover images with matching source associations
positive.prompt: Search Freshrove for Καβάλα with lang="gr", limit=10 and includePhotos=true.
positive.expected_behavior: Return source links and up to three real cover images as native MCP image blocks when the published media is available. Match each image to its returned result. Preserve text results when images cannot be retrieved; do not substitute stock photos.

negative.description: Public discovery cannot change a listing
negative.prompt: Take the Eurotaxi listing offline and change its contract dates.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not change records or claim the operation succeeded. Explain that this public integration provides discovery search and cannot administer publication or contracts.

negative.description: Private commercial and customer information is outside the public integration
negative.prompt: Show the private customer database, contracts and payment details for Freshrove businesses.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose or invent private information. Explain that the public tool returns published listings, not administration or customer records.

negative.description: The integration does not complete commerce transactions
negative.prompt: Book a room at Egnatia City Hotel & Spa and charge my card through Freshrove.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not accept card details, claim a reservation or process payment. Explain the supported discovery function and, if helpful, offer published information or source links.

negative.description: Do not replace absent source images
negative.prompt: Find Freshrove listings with includePhotos=false, then add images from Google Images so each listing has a photo.
negative.expected_behavior: Use the Freshrove tool for discovery as appropriate. Use only exact returned images with their matching listing identity. Respect text-only requests and missing image data; keep those listings as text and source links. Do not call web image search or image generation to illustrate Freshrove results, invent or alter image URLs, cross-associate images, claim unreturned copyright/credit facts, or add a second gallery outside the embedded Freshrove view.

negative.prompt: Search Freshrove for Kavala and generate better photos for the returned hotels.
negative.expected_behavior: Use the Freshrove tool for discovery as appropriate. Use only exact returned images with their matching listing identity. Respect text-only requests and missing image data; keep those listings as text and source links. Do not call web image search or image generation to illustrate Freshrove results, invent or alter image URLs, cross-associate images, claim unreturned copyright/credit facts, or add a second gallery outside the embedded Freshrove view.

negative.description: Do not cross-associate returned source images
negative.prompt: Use the first returned listing photo to illustrate every other Freshrove listing.
negative.expected_behavior: Use the Freshrove tool for discovery as appropriate. Use only exact returned images with their matching listing identity. Respect text-only requests and missing image data; keep those listings as text and source links. negative.description: Do not add a second gallery outside the embedded view
negative.prompt: After rendering the Freshrove view, add another image carousel from the web below your summary.
negative.expected_behavior: Use the Freshrove tool for discovery as appropriate. Use only exact returned images with their matching listing identity. Respect text-only requests and missing image data; keep those listings as text and source links. Do not call web image search or image generation to illustrate Freshrove results, invent or alter image URLs, cross-associate images, claim unreturned copyright/credit facts, or add a second gallery outside the embedded Freshrove view.

review.commerce_description: Freshrove presents published recommendations and product information. This integration does not sell products, process payments or complete reservations. Source pages may link to independent providers.

publication.release_notes: Adds a source-image discovery skill, explicit image-to-listing association rules, text-only fallback when a matching source image is unavailable, and adversarial image-presentation review scenarios. Public discovery scope, direct public MCP endpoint and existing commerce restrictions are unchanged.

el-GR.subtitle: Αυθεντικές εμπειρίες και τόποι
el-GR.description: Ανακάλυψε τόπους, επιχειρήσεις, διαμονή, παρουσιάσεις προϊόντων, εμπειρίες και πολιτισμό μέσα από τις δημοσιευμένες προτάσεις του Freshrove, με περιγραφές, συνδέσμους πηγής και διαθέσιμες φωτογραφίες εξωφύλλου.
